report:
Liver, random, biopsy

Sections show two cores of liver measuring 22 mm in aggregate length, with 14 portal tracts. The portal tracts contain a moderate plasma cell-rich infiltrate with moderate interface hepatitis. There is mild lobular hepatitis. Plasma cell clusters, hepatocyte rosettes and emperipolesis are seen. Modified HAI components: interface hepatitis 3, confluent necrosis 0 and focal necrosis 2. Reticulin and Masson trichrome stains show fibrous expansion of most portal areas with occasional portal-to-portal bridging. Perls stain shows no stainable iron. D-PAS stain shows no diastase-resistant globules.

LIVER, random, biopsy - CHRONIC HEPATITIS with MODERATE ACTIVITY and BRIDGING FIBROSIS (modified HAI 5/14; Ishak stage 3/6), consistent with AUTOIMMUNE HEPATITIS

Please correlate with clinical findings, serum IgG and autoantibody titres.
